quest.title: Neko Is a Cat: A "Good Turn" Comes Late
quest.description: Neko, "Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine," seems to have business with you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: You're here. The stone human says that he's just about done.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Come with me. The stone human is just over there.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Haha, the Lady Priestess is so overjoyed. This "Hibiki" must really have been someone of great importance to it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Trouble is, we don't know where she is...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Indeed, "Hibiki," "Asase Shrine," "Domeki"... these names are all quite concerning, actually.

choices.text: And where did you two pop out from?

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Well, you were all making such a racket, so of course we'd come over.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Still, there's something that I think you must know.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Taisuke, if you'd do the honors.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Ah right, of course, Miss Etsuko. So what we're going to say... concerns Seirai Island.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: The history of this place is very obscure, and while the Guild has attempted to specifically search for information regarding it, we've found very little...

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: According to what information we did manage to get, this was a gathering place for pirates several centuries ago. Then, it was the Shogunate who cleared all the pirates out and moved the inhabitants to other places...

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Unless I'm mistaken, this "Domeki" we speak of may well have been the pirate leader "Ako Domeki," who chose to fight the Shogunate head-on. The records do clearly record his name.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: According to that same information we have, this Ako Domeki led his pirate fleet in a naval battle against the Shogunate.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: They were quickly suppressed and forced to flee back to Seirai Island...

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: But as the Shogunate fleet pursued him, a sudden storm erupted on Seirai Island.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Ako Domeki's fleet and the Shogunate's were both caught in the ensuing storm... and they were all lost.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A storm...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: I'll pick things up from there. The biggest mystery here, of course, is the sudden emergence of that storm.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Although Ako Domeki's fleet was also hit by the storm and was nearly wiped out as a result, the fleet that the Shogunate sent was also all but lost with all hands, with the remnants being forced to retreat to Narukami Island. It would be quite some time before the fleet was ready again.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: So the timing of that storm was just too good. Almost as if... someone was specifically controlling it.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: I'm sure you remember the Warding Stones on this island. Those had been intentionally unsealed.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: And once we sealed them again, the storm on the island became calm once more.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: I'm not going to jump to conclusions immediately, but my gut says that those incidents are definitely related.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Well, we could ask Lady Neko...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: ...Eh, I say forget it. The record states that Domeki went missing — well, that's what it says anyway, but if he was hit by that storm, he probably...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: We'll continue exploring this island and collecting more information about this incident for a while, and then we'll report back to the Guild.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Who knows? Maybe we'll have the pleasure of working together again some time.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I look forward to it.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: The feeling's mutual.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Well, Taisuke, let's ready up. We've got some exploring to do.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Uh, so Miss Etsuko, about Lady Neko...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: You can keep treating that cat just as you did before, of course.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Just remember to refrain from saying anything you shouldn't.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: It's a real happy camper right now. No need for you to be a wet blanket.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: I got it. Haha, Miss Etsuko, you really are...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: ...Just trying to finish our commissions more efficiently. C'mon, let's get to work.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Seirai Island... It seems that this place is still full of many mysteries...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Phew, we're almost done here. This was a big job if I've ever done one...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, and the Lady Priestess too.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: How is it? Is the statue complete?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Yes it is, as you can see, hehe! I actually left a little extra stone here — I was just waiting for the Lady Priestess to return before I chipped it off.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That was very thoughtful of you.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Well, of course. Shrine statues must be treated with the utmost formality, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow meow, is knocking on stone such an important thing?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Well, how should I say this... Usually, things that we make into statues are all very important.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You know, Paimon, you should probably get a statue of food made.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! That's rude!

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: So... you make statues of good things, you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Well, I'd say that they're better than just "good"! Statues are what you'd call "memorials to eternity," after all!

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: No, no, this isn't some "memorial to eternity."

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I only wish that Hibiki can look upon this statue should she return and be unable to find her way here.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: That way, she will know where to go and not get lost.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: O—Oh, I see. Lady Priestess, you really do care a lot about this "Hibiki," huh.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Neko...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hibiki will be back any time, after all. Also, she and Domeki said that something good would happen once the stone was complete.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Well then, stone human. Do you require me to do anything else?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Well, not really... Well, since you're here, Lady Priestess, I can chisel that last bit of stone off now!

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Three... two... one!

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Wh—What's with this cloud...

choices.text: It turned into the shape of a cat...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: It's Hibiki.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Eh?

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Hibiki?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Meow meow meow! It must've been Hibiki! A good thing happened, just like she said it would!

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: It's just like she said, it's just like she told me! A good thing would happen if that stone was completed!

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Wonderful, this is wonderful! What she said was true!

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Yes, she will certainly return!

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Hoo... Hooray! Hahaha, I don't know what's going on exactly, but given how pleased the Lady Priestess looks, this must indeed be a good thing.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Neko...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: With your help, the shrine is beautiful again.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: The Offering Box has been repaired.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: The Prayer Rack has been fixed.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: The stone has been built, too! Now, Hibiki will definitely return, won't she?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: And Domeki, Janome, and all of Hibiki's friends, too! They'll come back with her for sure!

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: You... you are a good person! Better than that meal! Hibiki will like you for sure!

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I must call all those little rascals together and make plans for her return. And... yes, of course, of course, the many people who will come to visit the shrine. I will need to give instructions concerning that as well...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: And there are all these other matters that must be settled first...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Oh, Hibiki... meow meow, meow! This is wonderful, wonderful!
